module.precedence: Additive adapter only. Original a16_retained_read, installed retained wire module, schemas, opaque definitions and Node routes remain unchanged. Its adapter definition digest is separate from the original returned RetainedSectionContract06 definition digest.

source_identity.wire_module_relation: Accepted installed public projection of original a16. Operational opaque/authority/projection/Host/budget rules are preserved; private proposal metadata and historical progress wording do not define the wire identity.

domain.origin: Original section-native-state.snapshots owner, with immutable view.verification.mode exactly whole_asset; typed WholeSectionSnapshot06 only.
domain.other_origins: Any token not resolving to a view whose verification.mode is whole_asset returns origin_untrusted/READ_SNAPSHOT_UNATTESTED before grant. Catalog-mode output from that whole origin retains the original whole proof. This adapter does not recognize catalog-origin, scoped-origin or protected-origin snapshots.
domain.non_node_runtime: Web platform JSON text, TextEncoder/TextDecoder, structuredClone, Uint8Array, native crypto.randomUUID and already accepted portable whole/IR graph. No Node builtins or dynamic module injection.

ingress.request: Primitive JSON text only, then existing strict duplicate-key and scalar parser, exact original tuple/version rules, generated original RetainedSectionRequest06 validator and private original retained-state.requests issuance. Caller object values are rejected before any reflection.
ingress.policy: Optional undefined uses original false/null policy; otherwise primitive JSON text and original SectionSignaturePolicy06 validator. Callback checked by typeof function only, not invoked at registration.
ingress.host: Separate observeJson and optional deliver function inputs; no caller callback object is reflected. observe result must be primitive JSON text before strict parsing or clone. Existing genuine provider brands alone do not validate an object-valued observation.

lifecycle.fresh_grant: Every preparation creates a fresh operation identity/context and invokes the current authority, including preparation from the same reusable snapshot/request.
lifecycle.signature: Reuse only the immutable original receipt and original signature policy check. No signature/domain/digest revalidation is claimed by retained proof.
lifecycle.prepared: Available token is atomically reserved before any Host await; invalid/foreign/used or simultaneous losing consume returns body-free READ_INPUT_INVALID transport before entering winner finally. Every consumed call closes and clears snapshot/view/request/plan/data references in finally.
lifecycle.handles: Mint tentatively from original projection/descriptor targets. Commit to the original provider handle registry only after literal true deliver for a ready result. False/throw/missing delivery gives not_confirmed transport and no handle commit; the callback may already have observed the bytes. Handles are reusable through fresh preparation/grant while time, epoch, origin, full value and scope remain valid.
lifecycle.read_origin: Read keeps the original shared PreparedRetainedSectionRead06 owner. After atomic reservation, before any Host observation, it requires origin.kind whole, the identical view held in the original native snapshots owner, and view.verification.mode whole_asset. A genuine same-owner catalog-origin preparation is consumed and closed, then returns body-free transport_failure with READ_SNAPSHOT_UNATTESTED semantic cause and validated request correlation; it is not classified as a foreign forged preparation. No projection/budget proof or Host callback is produced for that origin.

host_delivery.rules: Preserve original first and second full Host binding/scope/expiry/revocation/epoch rules; no additional generic first-to-second monotonic time rule. Scope covers projection nodes, descriptor nodes and every issuable handle target scope. Preserve original denial latch and explicit lift. Delivery must return literal true.
host_delivery.callback_exceptions: Never inspect or trust arbitrary exception fields; classify by the original bounded Host/core outcome. Controlled internal failures have immutable private registry codes.
host_delivery.trusted_callback_async_domain: Authority, observeJson and deliver are trusted embedding functions. Preserve original JavaScript await semantics for their return values: Promise/thenable assimilation can read or invoke then before settlement, including for an out-of-declaration object result. This execution is distinct from untrusted request/policy/token JSON/reflection boundaries. Non-string settled Host observations are still rejected before JSON parsing or cloning, and unknown thrown values are never inspected. Runtime evidence must count trusted callback assimilation hooks separately; no universal zero-hook claim is made for callback return values.

projection_budget.source: Original retained-plan and retained-read-project/selected-context logic, original proof/contract/receipt/omissions and original budget-decision semantics.
projection_budget.meter: Original canonicalInternalResponse/measureInternalResponse counts the entire constructed envelope with fixed 16-digit actual/required widths. No response truncation or 8 MiB clone of the whole proof is introduced. Existing per-scalar/depth/array and authored-input limits remain.
projection_budget.proof: Retain complete origin verification, signature policy check and new_capture:false, io:[], new_domain_validation:false, new_digest_computation:false. Internal origin/intent/receipt binding hashes are not new native A/C/E domain observations.

claims_not_established: full native browser support beyond whole origins
